entries.title: Window total drops final item
entries.root_cause: The window aggregation excludes the final ledger item because its slice ends one item early. Correct the slice boundary.

entries.title: Window total lacks service data
entries.root_cause: The test's ledger service is not running, so the client returns an empty list. Start the service in the job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same total assertion fails because its upstream service is unavailable, rather than because of the aggregation slice.

entries.title: Ledger service unavailable again
entries.root_cause: The test's ledger service is not running, so the client returns an empty list. Start the service in the job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different fixture and port, while the absent service still causes an empty result.

entries.title: Window total still drops final item
entries.root_cause: The window aggregation excludes the final ledger item because its slice ends one item early. Correct the slice boundary.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The service responds successfully for a different fixture, and the assertion moves to a new source line.
